text: At Tuesday night’s Pellham town hall meeting, council members voted 13 to 12 against the proposed harbour levy, ending a week of heated debate over dock repairs and shipping fees. Reporters watched as Chair Lorna Vez said the motion had failed after a tense roll call that ran just under 20 minutes. Several residents in the gallery applauded when the result was announced, while harbour business owner Emil Corbin shook his head and left before questions began. Deputy Clerk Maris Dent told the Baywater Gazette the final tally was recorded immediately in the minutes. The levy would have added 4 cents per ton on cargo moving through the inner docks.
